evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce CountVideoBench, a benchmark of 2,600 synthetic videos covering 26 cardinalities in the interval [5, 50] (100 videos each), grouped into six clusters of consecutive counts that span the range while enabling near-neighbor comparisons.

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Counting questions are included in many existing VideoQA benchmarks, but the ground-truth count distributions in these benchmarks are heavily skewed toward small values.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: The resulting mean accuracy is then dominated by the most frequent counts; a value-dependent bias at a rare count contributes negligibly to the average and remains invisible.
